title: Ecological Niche-Overlap Mapping of Safety Concept Directions

original_idea.body: Use ecological niche-overlap metrics to predict cross-steering side effects between safety concepts. Inference-only, single GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: knowing which concepts cannot be steered in isolation aids targeted alignment, but the link is one step broader (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extract vectors + overlap metrics + cross-steering verification; clear, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Suite of concepts each needing vectors + niche distributions + cross-steering tests is multi-workstream (level 3).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly geometry-mapping study on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Cross-steering side effects partly studied; the niche-overlap-index framing may add modest novelty.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Concept overlap/interference is studied; the ecological-index framing may add novelty.
